items.title: Putin envoy says Russia and US are discussing joint deals including on data centres
items.author: Vladimir Soldatkin, Olesya Astakhova
items.creator: Vladimir Soldatkin, Olesya Astakhova
items.summary: Russia and the US are discussing a range of new joint projects including nuclear-powered data centres in the wake of last week's agreement on diesel, President Vladimir Putin's investment envoy said on Friday.
items.body:
Russia and the US are discussing a range of new joint projects including nuclear-powered data centres in the wake of last week's agreement on diesel, President Vladimir Putin's investment envoy said on Friday.
Kirill Dmitriev said that US sanctions posed serious obstacles and criticised as "misguided" the Graham Act [USN:L1N45A0ZU TEXT:"signed by US President Donald Trump"] last month that aims to squeeze Russia's energy revenues through sanctions and tariffs.
Nevertheless, he said the two countries were considering other forms of economic cooperation in the wake of the diesel deal.
"We are also discussing joint projects in the field of Russian and US data centres, including with the use of small-scale nuclear power plants," he added, without giving details.
Ukraine has this month attacked data centres of Russian tech group Yandex and banking and technology group Sberbank in what it called a response to Russian strikes on its own sites.
Dmitriev, a key figure in Russia-US talks on ending the Ukraine war, has long been pushing for a range of ambitious potential deals including on minerals and energy.
The Kremlin has expressed frustration that the US until now has linked any such agreements to a peace deal, which remains elusive.
But Dmitriev expressed optimism that this was changing.
"Naturally, progress is quite difficult; there is resistance - widespread resistance, in fact - from various quarters. Yet, as the example regarding diesel demonstrates, I believe we will soon be announcing several other significant initiatives. The ice has, in fact, begun to break," he told the Russian Energy Week conference in Moscow.
"We are effectively implementing projects with the United States of America at this very moment, and we will continue to do so until the special military operation comes to an end," he added, using the Kremlin's term for the war.
Dmitriev said the US Treasury had asked Russia's sovereign wealth fund, which he heads, to help sort out tricky payment issues relating to the diesel agreement.
The [USN:L8N4610WB TEXT:"deal"] announced by Trump a week ago involves the supply of Russian diesel to US and global markets in order to lower the price of the fuel, a key priority for the US president ahead of next month's mid-term elections.
Fiercely [USN:L1N46209U TEXT:"criticised"] by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, it requires the removal of some sanctions on Russian oil that Trump himself has imposed.
"There are so many layers of sanctions piled on top of one another that everyone has become confused; it's difficult now to figure out how to navigate a way out of this situation," Dmitriev told the Moscow conference.
"Brainstorming sessions are already under way regarding how to lift these sanctions - that is exactly what the United States is currently working on."
He said his Russian Direct Investment Fund "will work to ensure that all payments are efficient and reach their intended recipients".

items.title: Dodge the cops, reach the protest: India's latest online political game goes viral
items.author: Tora Agarwala, Aftab Ahmed
items.creator: Tora Agarwala, Aftab Ahmed
items.summary: A web-based multiplayer game in which players dodge police and detention on their way to a protest site in New Delhi has gone viral, as young Indians use satire and humour to respond to police actions.
items.body:
A web-based multiplayer game in which players dodge police and detention on their way to a protest site in New Delhi has gone viral, as young Indians use satire and humour to respond to police actions.
As [USN:L6N46206J TEXT:"youth-led protests"] over [USN:L4N3TC0XX TEXT:"jobs"], [USN:L4N43O0C9 TEXT:"exam paper leaks"] and [USN:L4N45K0E7 TEXT:"voter roll revisions"] spread across India, a growing crop of online games is transforming political grievances into shareable digital content.
The trend shows a generation raised on Instagram is expressing dissent in ways that differ sharply from the political communication style of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
One such game, 'Jantar Mantar Chalo', was developed by 27-year-old IT professional Suraj Kushwah, who has described it as "dark humour".
The game satirises the difficulties protesters face in reaching Jantar Mantar, a main protest site in the capital, amid police blockades, road closures and public transport suspensions. Players can build a kafila, or procession, evade checkpoints and stage a demonstration, or switch sides and deploy batons and tear gas to disperse crowds.
"Whatever news was coming was kind of like a circus," Kushwah said.
"People were trying to reach Jantar Mantar. And they were getting detained. And I imagined it as a 3D game."
Kushwah said at least 2,000 people had been playing the game at any point in time since its release on October 14.
Another game casts firebrand left-wing activist [USN:L4N45X011 TEXT:"Neha Bora"] as the protagonist of a retro 8-bit-style platform reminiscent of classic arcade games.
"We as artists believe that satire is the most powerful way to talk about things," said 30-year-old Anav Nayar, who co-developed the game with his brother, Akshay.
The protests were triggered by the "[USN:L1N43O05A TEXT:"cockroach""] youth movement, which also started as a joke online.
The games draw inspiration from protests against the Election Commission's voter roll revision exercise, which opposition parties and activists say has disenfranchised 130 million eligible voters and favoured Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party.
The Election Commission and BJP deny the allegations.
Gen Z's style of expression poses an unusual challenge for Modi. After the "cockroach" movement forced the resignation of Modi's education minister in July, he intensified outreach to younger Indians through self-shot Instagram videos.
But analysts say Modi's outreach might not be enough.
"The BJP has long enough enjoyed its dominance of controlling the narrative online and on the ground, but this time the younger generation has countered them everywhere," said Rasheed Kidwai, a political analyst.

items.title: ¿Cómo el boom del cobre cambia los planes de austeridad de Kast en Chile?
items.author: Juan Pablo Álvarez
items.summary: El presupuesto de 2027 contempla un gasto 2,7% mayor al previsto anteriormente. Fitch advierte que la consolidación fiscal sigue dependiendo de los ingresos por materias primas y de recortes aún incie ...
items.body: El buen momento del cobre y los ingresos provenientes del litio le permiten al gobierno de José Antonio Kast contar con mayor margen para flexibilizar la austeridad fiscal en Chile. Sin embargo, Fitch Ratings advierte que la sostenibilidad de la consolidación de las cuentas públicas dependerá de la capacidad de las autoridades para concretar los recortes del gasto comprometidos y de que se mantengan los ingresos extraordinarios vinculados con las materias primas. La agencia de calificación crediticia señaló que la mejora fiscal chilena respondió más al incremento de los ingresos por el cobre y el litio que a los esfuerzos para contener el gasto. En particular, los mayores precios del cobre elevaron la recaudación pese a que los volúmenes de producción cayeron con fuerza. El Gobierno se comprometió a implementar medidas de austeridad por US$6.000 millones, equivalentes al 1,5% del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB). De ese total, US$2.000 millones corresponden a 2026. No obstante, Fitch considera incierta la capacidad de las autoridades para ejecutar los recortes necesarios para garantizar una mejora fiscal más duradera. VER MÁS: El auge del cobre sacude los mercados: por qué sube, quiénes ganan y qué esperar para 2027 El proyecto presupuestario para 2027 contempla un gasto 2,7% superior al previsto en el presupuesto anterior, según el análisis de Fitch. La diferencia responde, en parte, a que ahora se espera que el gasto de 2026 supere el presupuesto original, debido a nuevas medidas contracíclicas y a una mayor ejecución de la inversión pública durante la última parte del año. La proyección oficial de crecimiento real del gasto para 2027 es del 1,5%, pero se calcula sobre la base de la ejecución estimada para 2026 y no del presupuesto de ese año. Fitch señaló que los límites al gasto son menos estrictos que los previstos anteriormente, lo que amplía la flexibilidad del Gobierno para responder a la debilidad de la actividad económica. La composición del gasto también apunta a una mayor orientación hacia la inversión. El presupuesto de 2027 prevé un incremento del 7,3% en la inversión pública y del 0,6% en el gasto corriente. De acuerdo con Fitch, esta distribución busca preservar la disciplina sobre las partidas corrientes rígidas y redirigir recursos hacia la inversión. Para 2026, el Gobierno proyecta que el gasto real aumente un 2,4%. El cálculo contempla una mejora en la ejecución de la inversión pública y el programa contracíclico Chile Despega, por US$1.300 millones, que apunta a crear más de 100.000 puestos de trabajo. El menor crecimiento previsto para Chile constituye otro factor que condiciona el proceso de consolidación fiscal. El Ministerio de Hacienda redujo su proyección de expansión económica para 2026 al 0,7%, desde el 1,8%, en línea con las estimaciones de Fitch. La revisión oficial respondió al desempeño débil de la minería y a condiciones climáticas adversas. Además, el Indicador Mensual de Actividad Económica (Imacec) se contrajo un 1% interanual en agosto. Fitch atribuyó el resultado a interrupciones de la oferta relacionadas con la minería y a una demanda débil en un mercado laboral frágil. Según la agencia, el dato aumenta los riesgos a la baja para su previsión y la probabilidad de que Chile registre un crecimiento nulo o negativo en 2026. Para 2027, en cambio, el Gobierno espera que la economía crezca un 3,3%, por encima del 3% proyectado por Fitch. La estimación oficial supone una recuperación de la minería y la inversión, junto con un impulso adicional del programa Chile Despega. El presupuesto también incorpora un impacto negativo sobre los ingresos fiscales derivado de la Ley de Reconstrucción Nacional, que incluye una reducción de la tasa del impuesto corporativo y una exención temporal del IVA para viviendas nuevas. Las autoridades esperan que esas medidas favorezcan la recuperación de la inversión. La trayectoria fiscal también estará condicionada por la evolución del cobre y el litio. Fitch advirtió que una reversión de los actuales precios elevados amenazaría los ingresos extraordinarios que respaldan la mayor flexibilidad del gasto prevista para 2026 y 2027. No obstante, la agencia espera que continúen vigentes los factores globales que sostienen las cotizaciones actuales. La persistencia de los efectos de El Niño o una recuperación económica más lenta de lo previsto también podrían dificultar la consolidación fiscal, según Fitch. La agencia sostuvo que los recortes comprometidos podrían resultar necesarios para compensar el costo de la Ley de Reconstrucción Nacional y lograr una mejora más duradera de las cuentas públicas, sin depender de los precios de las materias primas. En septiembre, Fitch ratificó la calificación crediticia de Chile en ‘A-’ con perspectiva estable. La decisión reflejó, en gran medida, las expectativas de mayores ingresos y gastos, además de una trayectoria más estable de la deuda en relación con el PIB. VER MÁS: Supervisores de Escondida aprueban nueva oferta salarial y evitan huelga en la mina de cobre de Chile Con las nuevas proyecciones presupuestarias, el Gobierno espera que el déficit fiscal baje al 1,8% del PIB en 2026, frente al 2,8% de 2025, y se mantenga en ese nivel en 2027. Para el próximo año, también prevé que la deuda pública descienda moderadamente hasta el 42,5% del PIB, una estimación que coincide con la de Fitch.

items.title: 米製造業生産、9月は0.3％増　第3四半期は中東紛争背景に失速
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　１６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　１６日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１６日発表した９月の製造業生産指数は前月比０．３％増と、エコノミスト予想と一致した。前月から持ち直したものの、第３・四半期全体では、サプライチェーン（供給網）の混乱やエネルギー価格の高騰を招いている中東紛争を背景に、勢いは大きく失速した。  

８月分は当初の０．３％減から０．２％減に上方改定された。

９月は前年同月比では１．１％上昇した。第３・四半期は年率換算で０．７％増と、第２・四半期の５．６％増から大幅に鈍化した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラの構築や、底堅い国内需要に対応するための企業の在庫積み増しが製造業の活動を下支えする一方、エネルギー価格の上昇やカナダとの貿易戦争、借り入れコストの上昇が生産の下振れリスクとなっている。 

シティグループのエコノミスト、ベロニカ・クラーク氏は「ＡＩの強い需要が企業の設備投資を押し上げているが、その投資の多くは輸入によるものであり、国内生産はそれほど強くないことを示唆している」と述べた。

９月の耐久財の生産は０．１％の小幅増となった。第一次金属、機械、電気機器・家電製品・部品の生産増が押し上げ要因となった。

一方、自動車・同部品の生産は３．０％減少した。耐久財の生産は第３・四半期に３．８％増加した。ＡＩ関連投資ブームを背景に、半導体および関連電子部品の生産が２８．４％急増したことが一因。

非耐久財の生産は、前月比０．４％増加。ただ、第３・四半期は１．６％減少した。

鉱業生産は０．２％増加、第３・四半期は年率５．０％の伸びを示した。公益事業生産は冷房需要を背景に３．５％急伸した。第３・四半期は１４．８％のペースで増加した。 

鉱工業生産全体では０．７％増加。前月は０．１％増だった。前年同月比では２．２％増加。第３・四半期は２．８％増と、第２・四半期の４．８％増から伸びが鈍化した。

鉱工業部門の設備稼働率は７６．９％と、前月の７６．４％から上昇した。１９７２─２０２５年の平均を２．５％ポイント下回っている。

製造業の稼働率は前月の７５．８％から７５．９％に小幅上昇したものの、長期平均を２．３％ポイント下回った。

items.title: US solicits exchange of up to 17 million barrels of oil from strategic reserve
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The United States has issued a request for proposal for an exchange of up to 17 million barrels of crude oil from the nation's Strategic Petroleum Reserve, the Department of Energy said on Friday.
items.body:
The United States has issued a request for proposal for an exchange of up to 17 million barrels of crude oil from the nation's Strategic Petroleum Reserve, the Department of Energy said on Friday.
The exchange would be part of a global deal the US struck [USN:FWN3ZY1GJ TEXT:"in March"] to try to control fuel prices impacted by the war on Iran. Washington agreed then to loan 172 million barrels of oil from the SPR as part of a wider deal with about 30 countries in the International Energy Agency to release 400 million barrels from reserves around the world.
The US had previously offered to loan the last batch from the March deal in June. But the US revealed later that month that companies, required to pay premiums of up to 24% in the form of extra barrels of crude returned to the SPR, [USN:L1N42U0WE TEXT:"only agreed to borrow about 500,000"] barrels.

FAST

MILAN, Oct 16 : Euroleague Basketball unveiled a 10-year business plan on Friday that forecasts a sharp increase in the value of its clubs and the competition as it presses ahead with expansion after turning down an NBA collaboration offer at a shareholders' assembly this month.
Under the plan, which includes a shift to a franchise-based model, the collective value of Euroleague's licensed clubs is projected to triple to €5.4 billion ($6.07 billion) from an estimated €1.8 billion, while the league itself is expected to rise in value to €7.98 billion from €1.4 billion, or 5.7 times its current estimated value, over the next decade.
The plan, approved by all 13 shareholder clubs, targets €648 million in annual commercial revenue by the 10th year and €3.4 billion in distributions to teams over the decade, comprising €2.2 billion from revenue and €1.2 billion in franchise fees.
Expansion is central to the strategy, with potential windows in 2027 and 2031. Euroleague Basketball said it had received 15 binding offers worth a combined €1.2 billion.

The plans come as the future structure of European basketball remains in flux.
The current premier competition in European basketball, the Euroleague, has said it is open to collaborating with the NBA but voted this month against accepting an NBA proposal.
A senior executive at a Euroleague club told Reuters this month he expected the NBA to come back with an improved offer.
The NBA has said it intends to move forward with its NBA Europe project in 2027 whether or not it reaches an agreement with Euroleague.
With Euroleague pursuing its own franchise and expansion strategy, the window for an agreement is narrowing before the European basketball landscape changes. Without a deal, NBA Europe and Euroleague would enter into direct competition.

FAST

LONDON, Oct 16 : A surge in octopus numbers in British waters due to unusually warm seas is presenting fishermen with an interesting new catch — albeit one that's devouring one of their usual staples.
The value of British octopus exports rose to £12.8 million ($17 million) last year from £164,000 a year earlier, with demand driven largely by buyers in France and Spain, according to industry body Seafish.
However, researchers found that more than half of UK fishermen had reported negative impacts from octopus predation on crab, lobster and scallop stocks, with catches in some fisheries falling by 30 per cent to 50 per cent and losses to affected fisheries exceeding £10 million in 2025.
Fishermen, regulators and scientists met this week at a government-hosted conference after British octopus landings jumped nearly 1,500 per cent from 2021, rising to more than 3,700 metric tons from an annual average of about 220 tons.

The government said on Friday the conference would help inform future decisions on managing the emerging fishery, a challenge Spain and Australia have also faced in recent years.
Scientists studying the phenomenon say the current bloom is the largest seen off southwest Britain in at least 75 years.
"The sudden arrival of this fast-growing, short-lived and highly predatory species into British waters upends a lot of our established knowledge and expectations about our coastal ecosystems," said Mike Cohen, CEO of the National Federation of Fishermen's Organisations.
"They are both a threat and an opportunity for fishermen, and a massive challenge for fisheries management."
OCTOPUSES FEASTING ON BRITISH SHELLFISH
Anjali Goswami, chief scientific adviser in the government's environment department, said the rise in octopuses in British waters was "a stark reminder of how quickly our marine ecosystem can change".
While some fishermen have found a valuable new catch almost overnight, others say the predators are damaging shellfish stocks that underpin long-established fisheries.
Researchers have also reported widespread breeding of common octopus in British waters during the current event.
They say warmer waters, together with ocean currents and winds that may have carried octopus larvae north from France and the Channel Islands, are among the most likely contributors to the surge.
Research published this year found that every major octopus bloom recorded in the region over the past 125 years had coincided with unusually warm sea conditions.
($1 = 0.7497 pounds)

Source: Reuters

items.title: Starlink disruptions are being felt on the front lines of Ukraine
items.author: Sergiy Chalyi
items.creator: Sergiy Chalyi
items.summary: For one artillery unit fighting in eastern Ukraine, the US decision this week to reduce services provided by satellite company Starlink to the military had an immediate impact.
items.body:
For one artillery unit fighting in eastern Ukraine, the US [USN:L1N4610ZC TEXT:"decision"] this week to reduce services provided by satellite company Starlink to the military had an immediate impact.
Communications with headquarters were interrupted and internet speeds dropped, posing risks in a war where drones present a constant danger and up-to-date information on targets and threats can make the difference between life and death.
"Immediately after the announcement that the connection with Starlink was deteriorating, it really did have a negative impact," said Ukrlan, a 28-year-old serving with an artillery unit of the Special Rifle Police Battalion.
He asked to be identified only by his callsign, in keeping with Ukrainian military practice.
"We felt it straight away," he told Reuters from his bunker near the front line in the fiercely contested region of Donbas.
"The internet speed at our position had deteriorated significantly and communication with our headquarters and our command had deteriorated significantly."
According to officials, the White House issued an order to limit SpaceX's Starshield satellite system used by Ukraine for battlefield communications and drone operations.
A US official has denied that President Donald Trump ordered a deliberate slowdown of Starshield, and Trump said this week intelligence sharing with Ukraine continued.
Ukraine and its Western partners [USN:L1N46209U TEXT:"decried"] the slowdown as aiding Russia in the war, which began nearly five years ago with Moscow's full-scale invasion . The US says it wants to end the war and is working towards doing so.
While much of the focus has been on Starshield, the military-grade version of SpaceX's Starlink service, Ukrlan's comments point to broader disruptions affecting internet connectivity and speeds.
ROAR OF THE GUN Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy [USN:S8N4390AY TEXT:"told leaders"] in Brussels on Friday that Starlink services had improved but had not yet been fully restored, which he said put civilian lives at risk.
"Starlink is really necessary for Ukraine. And unfortunately, in short term, Europe can't replace this capability," said the EU's foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas.
Ukrlan's unit had been firing a howitzer at Russian targets from a heavily camouflaged position dug deep into the ground. Soldiers hurriedly prepared shells in a dark, timber-framed bunker by the light of head torches, covering their ears each time the gun roared and filled the space with smoke.
Ukrainian soldiers have said slower Starlink speeds have impaired the military's ability to detect and intercept incoming missiles and drones.
The US move to temporarily restrict the system came as President Donald Trump has pressured Kyiv to stop its attacks on Russian oil refineries.
He has blamed those strikes for soaring energy prices that are denting his Republican Party's prospects in the November midterm elections , although experts say that the spike is mainly the result of the US war with Iran.
For Ukrainians, the consequences of his approach are clear.
"At first he insisted very strongly that he would help us bring it to an end in a very short space of time," Ukrlan said, referring to Trump's promise to end the Ukraine war soon after his return to office.
"But we haven't seen any sign of that at all. And things are just getting worse every day, every week."

items.title: AkzoNobel, Axalta offer remedies in bid for EU approval for $25 billion deal
items.author: Yun Chee Foo
items.creator: Yun Chee Foo
items.summary: Dulux paint maker AkzoNobel and US peer Axalta Coating Systems have offered remedies in an effort to secure EU antitrust approval for their $25 billion merger, a European Commission filing showed on Friday.
items.body:
Dulux paint maker AkzoNobel (AKZO.AS) and US peer Axalta Coating Systems (AXTA.N) have offered remedies in an effort to secure EU antitrust approval for their $25 billion merger, a European Commission filing showed on Friday.
The companies put in their offer on Thursday, automatically triggering a 10 working day extension of the Commission's deadline to November. The EU competition enforcer did not provide details of the concessions in line with its policy.
The companies [USN:L1N45U0UA TEXT:"will offer to sell AkzoNobel's vehicle refinish business"] to address competition concerns and expect to secure EU clearance at the end of the preliminary review, sources told Reuters last week.
The Commission is expected to seek feedback from rivals and customers before deciding whether to give the deal the green light, demand more or open a full-scale investigation.
Axalta exclusively makes coatings, with a strong presence in the US market. BASF's (BASFn.DE) coatings business, Nippon Paint (4612.T) , Sherwin-Williams (SHW.N) and Kansai Nerolac (KANE.NS) compete with AkzoNobel and Axalta.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -  トランプ米大統領は、イランの核兵器保有を確実に阻止するため、同国の核開発計画に関連する施設「ピックアックス・マウンテン」を米国が攻撃する必要があるかもしれないと述べた。１５日夜、ニューズマックスとのインタビューに応じた。

トランプ氏は、米国はイランが決して核兵器を保有しないようにしたいとし、「保有すれば使用するだろうからだ」と語った。

「彼らの核関連施設は、数百万トンもの山の岩盤の下に埋まっている。今、われわれはピックアックス・マウンテンに目を向けている。そこを攻撃する必要があるかもしれない。攻撃を試みる。速やかに破壊する」と述べた。

トランプ氏は、対イラン戦争で、核兵器を使用することはないとも明言。「核兵器は使わない。その必要はない」と語った。

イランへの米地上部隊投入は検討していないとも改めて述べた。

大規模爆風爆弾「ＧＢＵ―４３／Ｂ」（ＭＯＡＢ）をイランのエネルギーインフラや核施設に対して使用することを承認したかどうかは明らかにしなかった。ただ、ＭＯＡＢは核爆弾ではないと述べた。

ピックアックス・マウンテンは、イランの主要核施設の一つに近い地下深くに設けられた、強固に防護された施設。

items.title: 3 goals of cybersecurity help you achieve a fourth
items.author: John Bandler
items.creator: John Bandler
items.summary: John Bandler of Bandler Law Firm PLLC outlines three sets of principles, or "triads," to help organizations understand and improve their cybersecurity program and achieve peace of mind.
items.body:
John Bandler of Bandler Law Firm PLLC outlines three sets of principles, or "triads," to help organizations understand and improve their cybersecurity program and achieve peace of mind.
This column features a trio of triads.
First are cybersecurity goals, which will help you understand and prioritize cybersecurity to improve your law firm or organization. These three goals will help you achieve an important fourth goal, which can even improve your mental state.
Knowing the next two triads helps you intelligently discuss cybersecurity principles with your technical and cybersecurity providers and experts, and to better understand cybersecurity laws and frameworks.
Consider these three goals of cybersecurity for your organization:
(1) Protect from cybercrime or other serious mishaps,
(2) Comply with legal requirements, and
(3) Fulfill the mission, including by improving efficiency and the management of information systems.
We introduced these goals in an earlier column (see, "Maintain and improve the cybersecurity program of your firm or organization", Reuters Legal News, Feb 17, 2026, https://bit.ly/3U1FjJ8) and will discuss further in a moment.
The Venn diagram from that article showed a bubble for each goal with some areas overlapping and others distinct.
Now we can add to that diagram and introduce the fourth goal, peace-of-mind, which encircles all three.
When organizations work honestly and effectively to achieve the three goals, while doing their reasonable best, that provides peace-of-mind. This is not a guarantee of imperviousness or success, but as much assurance and certainty as life and business can provide.
In contrast, when organizations ignore the three goals and neglect to work on their cybersecurity program, no such comfort can be achieved. Leaders are left with nagging worries in the pit of their stomach because important actions remain undone and the chances of damage are heightened.
If they fall victim to cybercrime, they may be accused of being negligent and sloppy, and it will be harder to defend against that claim.
Let's briefly consider what each of the three goals entails.
The goal of protect puts focus on preventing the bad things that could happen, including attacks by cybercriminals (data breach, ransomware, email-based frauds and thefts) and also system outages.
Protect is focused on traditional risk analysis; thinking about the harms that could occur, then deciding what to do about them — if anything. Often, this means taking steps to prevent them from happening in the first place, or reducing the damage that might result.
Comply focuses on the legal and professional duties of cybersecurity, and every organization has legal requirements there.
At the most basic level, think of simple negligence, and how organizations should expend reasonable and diligent efforts to achieve reasonable cybersecurity.
No firm leader would ever say, "We are content to take the negligent and sloppy approach to cybersecurity." Faced with such a claim by an outsider, they would defend and contest it, and attempt to show facts to demonstrate their cybersecurity was reasonable.
Don't wait for a cybercrime or such a claim to start thinking about your cybersecurity, take the steps now to ensure you can defend against such a claim later. By doing so, you will also reduce the chance of ever being subjected to it.
Attorneys have specific professional duties relating to cybersecurity and to protect client confidences and funds. Attorneys are lucrative cybercrime targets because they are involved directly and indirectly in a multitude of financial transactions and payments. Cybercriminals work to breach email accounts and redirect the transfers of funds to steal those payments.
All states impose legal requirements for data breach notification, and many states have cybersecurity requirements. Other laws and regulations may apply, depending on the sector.
In sum, every attorney, law firm, and organization has legal requirements relating to cybersecurity, and attorneys have professional ethical duties. Compliance with those rules protects and gives peace of mind.
Focus upon the goal of mission allows us to examine all the things that can go right when law firms, lawyers, and others properly manage their information assets. They can efficiently access email, contacts, and documents, spending more time doing work, life, and pleasure, and less time struggling with (or cursing at) IT systems.
In many ways mission comes first because no organization exists just to comply with rules, nor just to protect from cybercrimes. Law firms exist to serve clients (often this means bringing in revenue too) and every organization has a mission.
This "CIA" triad is a cybersecurity basic principle that is less intuitive but good to know since cybersecurity laws, frameworks, and professionals mention it. If you hadn't heard about the CIA triad before, now you can nod knowingly when you read or hear it next.
The three objectives of cybersecurity are:
•Confidentiality
•Integrity, and
•Availability.
Confidentiality means keeping unauthorized users from accessing the systems or data. Passwords, two-factor authentication, and hundreds of other measures help keep our data and systems confidential and safe. When a cybercriminal breaks into a law firm's email systems and documents, confidentiality has been violated.
Integrity means that only authorized users can make changes in your system. When a cybercriminal uses a lawyer's email systems to send an email which misdirects a bank wire, integrity has been violated.
Availability means that authorized users can access their systems and data when needed. Ransomware and other cybercrimes can remove the availability of data and systems.
In order to achieve the three objectives or three goals, organizations (and individuals) can apply appropriate cybersecurity controls, which are also known as cybersecurity safeguards. Think of these as more discrete tasks or steps along the way to a broader objective. Cybersecurity laws and frameworks incorporate this concept as well.
There are different ways to categorize these controls but an important way is with the initialism of "PAT," which stands for
•Physical
•Administrative, and
•Technical.
Physical controls restrict physical access in one way or another. Locking a door, a receptionist who controls access, securing your phone or purse while in a public place are all examples of physical controls.
Administrative controls include rules, policies, procedures, and training. Your organization should have a cybersecurity policy and conduct cybersecurity training.
Technical controls are electronic protections, such as a firewall, antivirus, or monitoring software.
These three control types illustrate that cybersecurity is not just about the technical aspects, but many others too, including those that are in the lawyer's wheelhouse.
A trio of triads.
We begin with the one that is less well known but is intuitive and simple to help us understand why we do cybersecurity and what we can achieve. Do these sufficiently and we get the fourth goal of peace-of-mind, knowing we are doing our reasonable, diligent best with cybersecurity.
Two are well-known and good to know, even though less intuitive to the casual observer. Cybersecurity professionals know them well and you will see their pattern imprinted upon many cybersecurity laws and best practices.
None of these triads replace the broader process of building and improving your organization's cybersecurity program, as we covered in prior articles. They do help with continual improvement and refined understanding of your program.
Fight the tendency for fear, uncertainty and doubt.
Remember that for each step of improvement that you take with your organization's cybersecurity, you travel further away from the nagging worries of tasks and duties left undone, and closer towards your peace of mind with reasonable cybersecurity or better.
John Bandler is a lawyer, consultant, author, and adjunct professor at Elisabeth Haub School of Law at Pace University. He helps protect organizations from cybercrime, improve cybersecurity and better protect and manage information systems. His latest book is "Cyberlaw: Law for Digital Spaces and Information Systems" (2025). His firm, based in New York, is Bandler Law Firm PLLC, and he can be reached at JohnBandler@JohnBandler.com.

WASHINGTON, Oct 16 : A new government task force on AI used its inaugural meeting to set up protocols, a risk study and various committees, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told CNBC on Friday, a day after gathering in Washington. 
Clayton leads the group, which Trump has dubbed the Super Intelligence Task Force to use his preferred term for artificial intelligence, along with Office of Personnel Management Director Scott Kupor, Federal Trade Commission Chairman Andrew Ferguson and Defense Department technology lead Emil Michael.     
Here are some of his comments:
• "We set out a protocol and a path for making sure that those accords are implemented and that we're in dialogue with the frontier labs."

• David Sachs will lead a risk study
• Three committees were established: reporting and response led by Michael; critical infrastructure led by Kupor; and law enforcement and responsibility led by Ferguson
• Workforce and economic impacts will be reported to the Department of Labor
• Clayton also told CNBC that any AI wrongdoing would be enforced through FTC or the Justice Department
• A White House readout of the first meeting, released late on Thursday, said the task force formally established the group for 120 days
• The readout also noted that a working group on implementation of the White House Accord would be led by Clayton along with National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross
• According to the White House, Michael's role would include reviewing and developing "protocols and mechanisms for labs to provide early warnings and systemized notifications to the government of breaches, hacks, jailbreaks, and other issues"

FAST

Oct 16 : Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez will be available for Sunday's Premier League game at Leeds United after the club accepted his apology for criticising its transfer policy, manager Michael Carrick said.
Martinez met Carrick and senior club officials on Thursday, two days after suggesting United needed greater investment to compete at the highest level following their 2-0 Champions League defeat by Atletico Madrid.
The centre back later apologised for his remarks and Carrick sought to downplay the episode when he spoke to reporters on Friday.
"We've moved on from that. It was one of those things. It's really not a drama for the group," Carrick said.

"The squad have trained really well and they are in good spirits. There is a freshness about the group...
"He's part of the squad (for Sunday)."
The Argentina international had singled out director of football Jason Wilcox in the post-game interview, saying United needed more signings to compete with their rivals and build a squad capable of challenging in Europe.
Martinez made the comments at a difficult time for United, who sit 13th in the Premier League table after winning only one of their opening six matches in their worst start in 40 years.
The manager said the club had accepted Martinez's apology.
"He's released his statement and realised he made a mistake. That's enough for us to move on with," Carrick said.
"I understand the emotion. We ask for passion. There's a way of doing that and that's been acknowledged. But we need to carry that passion in the right way."
Carrick, appointed permanently in May after overseeing the club's revival last season, has come under pressure following a poor start to the campaign, but said belief within the dressing room remained intact.
"I don't need results. We all need results. It's bigger than me... it's not about any individual player. It's about a football club," Carrick said.
"There's a lot of people saying a lot of things. That doesn't mean you know what's going on here.
"That doesn't distract us from what we are creating here as a group."
United travel to seventh-placed Leeds seeking their first victory in more than a month.

items.title: 米9月輸入物価、前年比8.1％上昇　4年超ぶりの大幅な伸び
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　１６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　１６日　ロイター] - 米労働省労働統計局が１６日に発表した９月の輸入物価指数は前月比１．１％上昇した。前年比では８．１％上昇と、２０２２年７月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。中東紛争が続く中、インフレ圧力が高まっていることを改めて示唆した。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は前月比０．８％上昇だった。８月分は当初発表の０．７％上昇から０．５％上昇に下方改定された。関税は輸入物価指数から除かれている。

９月の輸入燃料価格は前月比４．８％上昇し、８月の０．２％下落から反発した。輸入食品価格は横ばい。８月は０．６％下落していた。

輸入資本財価格は０．９％上昇。投資ブームを背景としたコンピューター、周辺機器、半導体の価格上昇に押し上げられた。

自動車を除く輸入消費財の価格は０．４％上昇した。耐久消費財が０．７％上昇したことがけん引した。輸入自動車・部品・エンジンの価格は０．３％上昇した。

食品とエネルギーを除くコア輸入価格は０．７％上昇し、伸びは前月から横ばいとなった。前年比では６．２％上昇した。

中国からの輸入価格は０．７％上昇し、２１年１２月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。前年比では３．１％上昇。日本、欧州連合（ＥＵ）、メキシコ、カナダからの輸入価格も上昇した。

輸入航空旅客運賃は１２．６％急騰した。７月と８月は下落していた。

今週発表された消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）と卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）はいずれも大幅な伸びを示しており、エコノミストの間ではインフレがエネルギー部門を超えて波及しているとの見方が強まっている。米国・イラン戦争が長期化する中、サプライチェーン（供給網）は混乱し、原油価格は高止まりしている。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「米国人はあらゆる面でインフレの脅威に直面しており、ほんの数カ月前までは安かった同じ商品に少し多く払わなければならない状況にある」と指摘。「２５年１月に第２次トランプ政権の経済政策が始動する前には、輸入物価のインフレは見られなかったが、今年はいたるところでインフレが起きている」と述べた。

FAST

BANGKOK, Oct 16 : The artificial intelligence boom is setting off a global race for money, forcing central bankers to contemplate a future in which interest rates stay higher and governments need to tighten their belts after an era of largesse.
From silicon chips and data centres to power grids and telecoms networks, governments and companies are pouring money into projects tied directly or indirectly to AI, adding fuel to the global economy and pushing up borrowing costs.
Central bankers from the world's largest economies gathering in Bangkok said the boom was also creating fresh inflation pressures and financial risks, because the investment is arriving long before the productivity gains AI promises.
"If you're a central banker...you've got to recognise this as a shock," Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok. "It's obviously hitting the demand side of the economy before it's going to hit the supply side."

Warsh, who said the US was benefiting from a broadening "surge of investment", warned the transition could be "very bumpy" as investors, companies and policymakers grappled with a technology whose ultimate winners remain unclear.
Several of his colleagues from the G20 group of large economies also in the Thai capital said it would only take a slight reassessment of the rosy earnings prospects underpinning AI investments to cause profound market ructions, as a selloff in Asian tech stocks showed this week.
STARS BEHIND THE CLOUDS
The debate marks a striking shift from the years following the 2008 financial crisis, when policymakers worried about excess global savings and inflation that was persistently too low.
Now central bankers increasingly see the opposite problem: too much demand for capital.
"There is a global fight for money," ECB policymaker Martins Kazaks told Reuters. "Investment in AI is one of the key factors driving up the cost of money."
That pressure is being amplified by governments from the United States to Japan and Germany borrowing heavily for defence, industrial policy and energy projects.
For central bankers, the implication is that the level of interest rates needed to keep economies on an even keel, known as R-star, may be rising.
"The problem at the moment in calculating the R-star is that the stars are covered by the clouds, and the clouds are so thick," South African Reserve Bank Governor Lesetja Kganyago said. "We know that R-star is higher, but we do not know how high."
A higher neutral rate means the same level of interest rate is less restrictive than previously thought.
"Maybe rates, on average, will be that little bit higher," said Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill.
The Bank of Japan has already cited AI-related demand as a factor behind its recent rate increases, arguing that investment-driven price pressures have become broader and more persistent.
Economists expect the Bank of England to raise rates at its next meeting on November 5. The ECB and Fed raised rates in September, and markets have priced in another move by them both in December. 
NO MORE CHEAP MONEY
The prospect of structurally higher borrowing costs poses a challenge for governments that built up large debts during years when interest rates hovered near zero.
Sovereign bond yields have risen across the world, and in recent weeks some have reached levels not seen since before the global financial crisis.
The euro zone, and notably debt-laden France, was seen as particularly exposed.
Much of the AI-driven investment surge is taking place in the United States and, to a lesser extent, Japan and other parts of Asia, with ASML and Siemens among the few clear European winners.
Meanwhile, the bloc faces higher energy costs from wars in Iran and Ukraine, compounding inflation pressures and squeezing public finances.
"There are particular circumstances that lead to some countries being more affected, France being a case in point," ECB President Christine Lagarde said at a CNN event in Bangkok. "And for that one, the primary and first solution lies at home in France. And it has to do with fiscal policies."

(Additional reporting by David Milliken and David Lawder; Editing by John Mair and)

Source: Reuters

FAST

BANGKOK, Oct 16 : The head of the IMF on Friday appealed to global leaders to cooperate in the face of multiple economic risks, including rapid advances in AI and a prolonged war in the Middle East, as Washington hailed what it sees as US-led economic momentum.
Their contrasting views echoed throughout this year's annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in Bangkok, as finance officials and central bankers from around the world took stock of a global economy rocked by high inflation and rising interest rates that have kept growth sluggish and increased inequality.
The IMF on Tuesday slightly raised its global growth forecast to 3.1 per cent in 2026, well below the historical average, as it flagged significant growth and financial stability risks from a potential ending of the AI investment boom, growing debt levels and the ongoing Middle East conflict.
Absent the US-Israeli-led war against Iran and Tehran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz that triggered a massive global energy shock, the IMF has said it would have expected AI to have fueled much stronger growth.

On Friday, IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva said the sheer speed of technological change added to the long list of challenges, including disruptions to the global trading system, high food and energy prices and lingering wars, all of which threatened to widen the gulf between advanced economies and the world's poor.
Bond markets, she said, were clearly sensing the risks, with US, German and Japanese 10-year sovereign yields reaching their highest levels in decades.
"The need of the hour is for urgent and practical international cooperation," Georgieva, the first IMF chief from an emerging market economy, said at a plenary session on Friday. She told a subsequent panel that she spent sleepless nights worrying about how to regulate AI and ensure that poorer countries weren't left behind by its breakneck-speed development.
US Treasury Under Secretary Erin Browne, in a call with reporters, pushed back against those warnings, hailing record highs on the US stock market, strong US economic output and improvements in Japan's economy.
"The IMF needs to take a more balanced approach to assessing the global economic outlook," she said, adding: "The global economy has demonstrated significant resilience with strong US growth helping to support broader economic and financial stability."
She said that the Fund should give equal consideration to "opportunities for positive economic shocks, particularly those driven by American innovation and super intelligence, energy abundance, and productivity-enhancing reforms."
US President Donald Trump's policies on tax, trade, energy and deregulation were paving the way for stronger investment, higher productivity and durable economic growth, she said.
AI JITTERS HIT STOCKS
Emerging market stocks have been volatile in recent weeks, roiled by expectations of higher US interest rates that have sent borrowing costs sharply higher. Major markets have also been hit by the growing concerns over the AI investment cycle.
South Korean shares posted their biggest weekly fall in 18 years as investors questioned the sustainability of the AI boom, while Japan's stock market lost 5.4 per cent over the week.
Eli Remolona, governor of the Philippines' Bangko Sentral ng Pilipanas, said in an IMF panel discussion earlier in the week that he was concerned Asia had not learned the lessons of its destructive financial crisis in the late 1990s.
Before the Asian financial crisis broke out in 1997, economies drew huge capital inflows that prompted the World Bank to describe it as the "East Asian miracle," Remolona said.
"Investment poured into Asia, and then you had the crisis because it wasn't really a miracle. I think we have to remind ourselves about that. We have to guard against that kind of crisis," he said on Wednesday. "We have not really been making a lot of effort looking at that kind of crisis."
Illustrating the vulnerability to sudden shifts, Indonesian stocks fell 11.6 per cent on Friday, their steepest one-day fall in 28 years, after global index provider MSCI said the Indonesian market was no longer worthy of "emerging market" status.
Officials at the IMF and World Bank this week said they are seeing elevated demand for grant and loan programs.
IMF strategy chief Christian Mummsen said the IMF's low-interest lending to low-income countries had quadrupled since the COVID pandemic, and demand was expected to remain strong. About 60 per cent of the IMF's financing since COVID had gone to low-income countries, he said. 
Developing countries are increasingly outspoken about their concerns. Barbados this week joined a group of countries calling for the creation of an international panel to address inequality, citing geopolitical tensions, climate change and rapid technological advances that could further divide wealthy and poorer nations.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Thousands march in Albanian capital as anti-government protests spread
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Thousands of young Albanians marched through Tirana on Friday, breaking some windows and traffic lights on the fourth day of an increasingly violent student-led campaign to force Prime Minister Edi Rama to resign.
items.body:
Thousands of young Albanians marched through Tirana on Friday, breaking some windows and traffic lights on the fourth day of an increasingly violent student-led campaign to force Prime Minister Edi Rama to resign.
The demonstrations, which are spreading through the country, [USN:L1N4610AQ TEXT:"turned into a riot"] in the capital on Thursday, with protesters smashing windows, raiding a bank and clashing with police. They follow months of mostly peaceful demonstrations that the students say the government ignored.
"They are pushing us to the limits," said 19-year-old protester Enea, declining to give a second name for fear of arrest. He said his message to Rama was: "To resign as fast as possible before everything burns down."
The students accuse officials of corruption and neglecting education and say they are angry about the sale of pristine parts of Albania's coast to a luxury resort development backed by US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner.
The unrest is a challenge for Rama, who won a fourth term last year on promises to take Albania into the European Union and is aiming for membership as early as 2028.
"We will not bow to violence," he said on Facebook.
BUSINESSES APPEAL TO PROTESTERS TO LEAVE THEM ALONE The students, many wearing masks, faced off against lines of riot police in front of the Education Ministry building. Some small businesses had their shutters down and notes on their facades saying: "We are with you. Do not damage our business all over the town."
In the coastal town of Lezha, police clashed with stone-hurling protesters. Protests have also spread to Elbasan, Skhodra and Korca, where demonstrators broke windows and set fire to garbage bins, local media reported.
"We've been protesting peacefully for 140 days, and nothing was heard. So this is our only chance to be heard and get our rights that we deserve," a 19-year-old protester who gave her name only as Klea said.
The demonstrations were sparked by the plans to build the resort, which has faced legal challenges.
Villagers told Reuters in July that their land was wrongfully sold for development. Reuters later reported that the man who sold the land was wanted by prosecutors for drug trafficking, charges his lawyer denied.
Reuters found no evidence of wrongdoing by Kushner, who is not directly involved in the villagers' dispute.
Political analyst Afrim Krasniqi said younger generations saw no future in Albania. "They see that all resources in the country, political resources, economic, everything is in the hands of oligarchs," he told Reuters.
Corruption scandals have tarnised Albania's image over the years and analysts say the country is a hub for gangs seeking to launder money from drugs and weapons trafficking, complicating its efforts to join the EU.
Along with Montenegro, Albania is leading the accession process among Balkan countries.
The unrest is part of a wave of student activism in Europe. In France, high school students [USN:L1N45Z0DG TEXT:"have staged weeks of protests"] and school blockades demanding more teachers and better facilities, arguing that deteriorating school buildings and overcrowded classrooms are undermining education.

items.title: 基調物価2％の判断、10月会合でしっかり議論　経済は見通し通り＝日銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Takahiko Wada　Takaya Yamaguchi

［１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Takahiko Wada　Takaya Yamaguchi

［１６日　ロイター］ - 日銀の植田和男総裁は１６日、基調的な物価上昇率について、２％に「かなり近づいている」と指摘する一方で、２％目標に到達したかの判断は２９日からの金融政策決定会合で「政策委員の間でしっかり議論して結論を出したい」と述べるにとどめた。

９月の決定会合以降の経済のデータは「おおむね見通し通りに動いている」とし、今回の出張で様々な当局者と意見交換をしたが、自身の見立てと「矛盾するような重要な情報がもたらされたとは考えていない」と話した。

主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）財務相・中央銀行総裁会議などへの出席のため訪問したタイ・バンコクで会見した。

植田総裁は基調物価が２％に迫る中、「（基調物価が）これ以上上がることは容認できず、その定着を政策の大きな目標にする」と説明した。植田総裁は９月の決定会合後の会見で「政策の局面が変化した」と言及していた。

インフレ圧力について、中東情勢と人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要の高まりを特に注視してきたが、日銀と各国当局者の間で見解に「大きな食い違いはないとの印象を持った」と述べた。ＡＩ関連の需要動向について、日銀よりも「やや心持ちしっかりしているとみている当局者が少し多いと思った」とも話した。日銀は１０月会合で「経済・物価情勢の展望」（展望リポート）を議論する。

植田総裁は、基調物価が２％に近づき、金融環境が緩和的な中で、経済・物価・金融情勢に応じて「政策金利を引き上げて緩和度合いを調整していく」と述べた。政策調整のタイミングやペースについては、中東情勢やＡＩ関連の需要動向、為替相場の動きを見ながら、見通しの確度やリスクを点検しながら検討していくと改めて説明した。

中立金利については「はっきりとこの辺にあると申し上げられるような材料があるわけではない」とし、これまでの利上げの累積的な効果を見極めながら判断していきたいと述べた。

８月３１日から９月１日に米国・アッシュビルでＧ２０や主要７カ国（Ｇ７）の財務相・中銀総裁会議が開かれた際、植田総裁はベセント米財務長官と会談した。この日の会見では、アッシュビルでの会談以降は「コミュニケーションは特に取っていない」と述べた。ウォーシュ米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）議長とは「様々な意見交換をした」としたが、具体的な内容は明らかにしなかった。

植田総裁とともに会見に臨んだ三村淳財務官は、足もとの金融市場の状況について「今に限らず、いつにあっても常に金融市場の状況をしっかりと注視し、決しておかしなリスクが顕在化しないようにしっかりと取り組む」と述べた。

items.body:
AIに仕事を奪われる？人員削減進むアメリカで84％が「雇用の脅威」…年収1700万超“技能職”逆転の波　日本も数年内に配置転換か【Nスタ解説】

TBSテレビ

2026年10月16日(金) 21:47

国際
Nスタ

エンタメ業界を襲うAI波及　表現者を守るためのルール作りは?

高柳キャスター:

ロイター通信などがアメリカの有権者を対象に行った最新の世論調査では、 「AIが雇用を奪う脅威」と回答をした人は84% に上っています。

この数字だけを切り取っても高いと感じますが、不法移民を「雇用の脅威」と答えた人が60%なので、その数字を大きく上回っている水準でもあります。

実際に、雇用に影響は出ているのでしょうか?

JNN米・ロサンゼルス支局　吉田駿平 記者:

様々な分野で影響が出ていますが、特に大きな影響を受けているのが「ハリウッドのエンタメ業界」です。

AIツールの活用で、映像制作の作業が大幅に効率化し、多くの制作スタッフや俳優、声優らが仕事を失う危機に直面しています。

【人員削減されたエンタメ業界】

▼ウォルト・ディズニー

4月:1000人

7月:数百人

▼Netflix

約1000人（全従業員の6%相当）

今回取材した声優のリベラさんによると、「AI音声は人間の声を学習させることによって、人の感情まで表現できるように改良されつつある」ということで、「数年後には、AIと人間の区別がつかなくなるのではないか」と不安を口にしていました。

高柳キャスター:

表現者を守るルール作りについて、ロサンゼルスではどのように整備されているのでしょうか?

JNN米・ロサンゼルス支局　吉田駿平 記者:

カリフォルニア州では先日、AI俳優やAI音声を広告に使った場合は、その旨を明記しなければいけないという法律が作られました。

徐々にではありますが、表現者を守るためのルール作りが整備され始めています。

AMSTERDAM, Oct 16 : Websites and online delivery services at grocery chains belonging to Dutch supermarket operator Ahold remained offline for a fifth day on Friday following what the company has described as a "cybersecurity incident" that prompted it to shut down some of its own IT systems. 
An Ahold spokesperson said the parent company cannot comment about the situation at its individual chains. Its US brands, which include Stop & Shop, Giant Food, Hannaford and Food Lion, are collectively one of the largest food retailers in the United States. Physical stores remain open. 
Ahold's Albert Heijn chain, the Netherlands' largest, has been gradually recovering from the shutdown that began October 11, disrupting its distribution centres and leading to empty produce shelves. Albert Heijn does not expect online delivery to resume before Sunday.
The Netherlands' Justice Minister David van Weel called on the company on Friday to file a criminal complaint over the incident, which Ahold has avoided describing as a hack, saying in a statement that no "customer, associate and partner data was taken".

"I understand that in the heat of the moment, a company like this is concerned with preventing damage to its systems and is not immediately looking outward," the minister told Dutch press agency ANP. "I think that we're in calmer waters now and the time has come to take this step."
The Ahold spokesperson said the company could not respond to the politician's remarks and pointed to its most recent statement on October 14, in which it said the company was working with relevant internal teams and external cybersecurity experts and engaging with the appropriate authorities and other stakeholders as necessary.
That statement said that because Ahold's investigation is ongoing, it could not share details about what happened in order not to undermine its own security or interfere with its response.

items.title: ロシア無人機、ウクライナ各地攻撃　3人死亡
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [キーウ（キエフ） １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[キーウ（キエフ） １６日 ロイター] - ウクライナ当局によると、１６日未明に各地でロシアの無人機（ドローン）攻撃があり、少なくとも３人が死亡した。商業施設２カ所が攻撃を受けたほか、北西部では電力網への攻撃で約３７万人が停電の影響を受けた。

ハルキウ州知事によると、東部ハルキウ市の３地区への攻撃で２人が死亡、１２人が負傷した。同氏は当初、死者を３人としていた。

ポーランドと国境を接する北西部ヴォルィーニ 州では、食品加工施設への攻撃で１人が死亡、８人が負傷した。

当局によると、前線に近い北部スムイ市と、ヴォルィーニ州に隣接するリウネ州でも、それぞれ少なくとも１カ所の商業施設が攻撃を受けた。

items.title: US import prices increase; post largest annual gain in more than four years
items.author: Lucia Mutikani
items.creator: Lucia Mutikani
items.summary: US import prices increased more than expected in September, boosted by higher costs for energy products and a range of other goods, further evidence of rising inflation pressures as the Middle East conflict persists.
items.body:
US import prices increased more than expected in September, boosted by higher costs for energy products and a range of other goods, further evidence of rising inflation pressures as the Middle East conflict persists.
The report from the Labor Department on Friday followed data this week showing strong increases in [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"consumer"] and [USN:L1N460127 TEXT:"producer"] prices last month, which left economists convinced that inflation was broadening beyond the energy sector.
The drawn-out US-Israeli war with Iran has snarled supply chains, and is keeping oil prices elevated. Economists have attributed rising inflation to President Donald Trump's policies, including tariffs on imports and the Middle East conflict. A Reuters/Ipsos poll also showed about 78% of Americans [USN:L6N45T0W3 TEXT:"blamed Trump's"] policies for the rising cost of living.
"Americans face an inflation threat literally on every front and everywhere they turn they have to reach in their pocketbooks and pay a little bit more for the same goods that were cheaper just a few months ago," said Christopher Rupkey, chief economist at FWDBONDS. "There was no import goods inflation before Trump 2.0 economic policies started to roll out in January 2025, but this year it is everywhere."
Import prices jumped 1.1% last month after rebounding by a downwardly revised 0.5% in August, the Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics said. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast import prices, which exclude tariffs, increasing 0.8% after a previously reported 0.7% advance in August. In the 12 months through September, import prices rose 8.1%, the largest gain since July 2022, after increasing 6.7% in August.
Despite inflation heating up in September, financial markets still expected the Federal Reserve to skip raising interest rates later this month and tighten monetary policy in December.
The US central bank in September raised its [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"overnight benchmark interest rate"] by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range. Fed Chairman [USN:S0N40K04F TEXT:"Kevin Warsh,"] speaking in Bangkok, Thailand, on Friday gave no preview about whether he feels more interest-rate hikes will be needed, or when, in keeping with his style since taking the reins as central bank chief in May.
Stocks on Wall Street were mixed. The dollar fell against a basket of currencies. US Treasury yields fell.
Imported fuel prices rebounded 4.8% last month after falling 0.2% in August. Food prices were unchanged after dropping 0.6% in August. Excluding food and fuels, import prices advanced 0.7%, matching the prior month's increase. The so-called core import prices rose 6.2% in the 12 months through September.
Capital goods prices increased 0.9% after rising by the same margin in August, boosted by prices for computers, peripherals and semiconductors amid an AI investment boom.
There was also a rise in the cost of imported industrial and service machinery, which more than offset a decline in the prices of scientific and medical machinery.
ACCELERATION IN INFLATION ANTICIPATED Prices for imported consumer goods, excluding automotives, increased 0.4%, driven by a 0.7% surge in the cost of long-lasting manufactured goods. The cost of imported automotive vehicles, parts and engines increased 0.3%.
Prices of imports from China increased 0.7%, the most since December 2021. Prices gained 3.1% in the 12 months through September. There were also increases in the prices of imports from Japan, the European Union, Mexico and Canada.
The report also showed a 12.6% surge in import air passenger fares last month after declining in July and August.
Economists said the international airfares component that goes into the calculation of the Personal Consumption Expenditures price indexes, the inflation measures tracked by the Federal Reserve for its 2% target, was unchanged after they adjusted the data for seasonal fluctuations.
Economists' estimates for the increase in September's core PCE price index were little changed in the 0.31% to 0.36% range, which could round up to 0.4%. That would translate to a year-over-year rise of 3.1%. Core PCE inflation gained 0.2% in August and advanced 3.0% on a year-over-year basis.
"We're looking for inflation to accelerate in the near term but not plateau at a higher level," said Oren Klachkin, financial markets economist at Nationwide. "That said, the risk is inflation remains higher for longer than we expect and is more difficult for the Fed to vanquish."
Though the AI investment spree is contributing to fueling inflation, it is also underpinning manufacturing. A separate report from the Fed showed [USN:L1N46110A TEXT:"factory production"] rebounded 0.3% in September, also supported by businesses replenishing inventories to meet robust domestic demand. Output fell 0.2% in August. It advanced 1.1% on a year-over-year basis in September.
But factory production lost significant momentum in the third quarter, growing at a 0.7% annualized rate after accelerating at a 5.6% pace in the April-June quarter.
Manufacturing accounts for about 9.4% of the economy. Output of semiconductors and related electronic components surged 28.4% last quarter, which some economists shrugged off. Motor vehicle and parts production fell 3.0% in September and contracted at a 3.4% rate last quarter.
"While strong AI-demand has boosted business investment, much of this investment is imported, implying domestic production has not been as strong," said Veronica Clark, an economist at Citigroup.
Outside AI-supporting industries, downside risks to production are mounting from elevated energy prices, a trade war with Canada, rising borrowing costs and fading stimulus from tax incentives. Record high diesel prices could soon raise the cost of goods, including at the supermarket, weighing on demand.
Capacity utilization for the manufacturing sector edged up to 75.9% from 75.8% in August. It is 2.3 percentage points below its long-run average.
"This means producers may be inclined to absorb some of the increase in energy and other input costs, but clearly not all, as suggested by this week's heated consumer and producer price reports," said Sal Guatieri, a senior economist at BMO Capital Markets.

items.title: US Project Vault readies $1B loan blitz for industry
items.author: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.summary: Federal-backed financing aims to help US manufacturers secure essential metals and materials amid supply risks.
items.body:
US Project Vault readies $1B loan blitz for industry

Staff Writer | October 16, 2026 | 5:39 am
Battery Metals   Critical Minerals   Suppliers & Equipment   Africa   USA   Cobalt   Copper   Lithium   Nickel   Rare Earth   Specialty Minerals  

Trump addressing coal industry representatives. ( Image courtesy of The White House. )

The US government-backed Project Vault is preparing to issue up to $1 billion in loans to American manufacturers seeking critical minerals, advancing Washington’s efforts to shield domestic industry from supply disruptions.

VaultCo, the entity managing the stockpiling initiative, is in discussions with more than 70 companies across the critical minerals supply chain, Bloomberg reported . The first round of financing is expected to cover more than a dozen original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), with another group to follow.

“What’s likely to happen is we’ll announce several hundred million dollars, maybe a billion dollars, of loans to OEMs who have requested use of the Vault facility,” VaultCo Executive Chairman Brett Lambert told the news outlet. “In the first tranche, we’ll have more than a dozen firms, followed by more than a dozen shortly after.”

The financing would mark a significant step towards making Project Vault operational as the US seeks to reduce its exposure to volatile critical minerals markets and strengthen manufacturers’ access to materials essential for industrial production.

Trump launches $12B ‘Project Vault’ to cut China reliance

Lambert said the recipients would not be publicly identified at this stage, although the announcement is expected to disclose the types of minerals they have requested.

Stockpile takes shape

Launched in February , Project Vault is structured as an independently governed public-private partnership backed by a $10 billion loan from the US Export-Import Bank (EXIM) and nearly $2 billion in private investment.

Commodity trading giants Glencore (LON: GLEN) and Mercuria recently committed $500 million each , becoming the first commodity traders to join the initiative.

Mercuria has already delivered 12,000 tonnes of copper from the Democratic Republic of Congo , establishing a new destination for the African country’s metal within Washington’s supply security strategy.

Glencore, Mercuria to help build US minerals stockpile with $1B EXIM financing

The shipment comes amid growing US demand for Congolese copper. Imports reached a record 53,290 tonnes in July, driven by competitive prices, improved product quality and concerns over potential tariffs that prompted buyers to accelerate shipments.

Commercial imports and Project Vault serve different purposes. While conventional purchases meet immediate industrial demand, the reserve is intended to provide manufacturers with access to materials when normal supply channels become disrupted.

Tailored mineral demand

Unlike conventional government stockpiles, Project Vault is designed around manufacturers’ specific requirements rather than predetermined inventories of strategic commodities.

Participating companies have requested not only raw metals and minerals but also specialized magnets, powders, alloys and other processed materials tailored to their production needs.

“There isn’t any one mineral that stands out, but the specificity of the requests have surprised me,” Lambert told Bloomberg .

The demand-driven approach allows manufacturers to determine which materials are purchased and stored, potentially giving smaller buyers greater purchasing power in fragmented and often opaque markets.

Op-Ed: US has built a strategic copper reserve. Now can it keep it?

It also distinguishes Project Vault from the US National Defense Stockpile , which the Defense Logistics Agency administers to secure materials required for national defence.

The next test will be whether the initial loans can translate manufacturers’ highly specific requests into reliable inventories, particularly for processed materials that may be harder to source than raw commodities.

items.title: Hedge funds bet Japan reforms have further to run at Sohn Tokyo
items.author: Summer Zhen, Rocky Swift
items.creator: Summer Zhen, Rocky Swift
items.summary: The next phase of Japanese corporate reform took center stage at the Sohn Conference in Tokyo, as hedge fund managers highlighted investment opportunities ranging from a financial conglomerate's capital allocation strategy to an X-ray scattering firm's AI solutions.
items.body:
The next phase of Japanese corporate reform took center stage at the Sohn Conference in Tokyo, as hedge fund managers highlighted investment opportunities ranging from a financial conglomerate's capital allocation strategy to an X-ray scattering firm's AI solutions.
At the inaugural Sohn Conference in Japan, which invited 14 funds to pitch their top investment ideas, more than half of the investors favored the theme of corporate reform.
Daisuke Nakayama, a portfolio manager at Hong Kong-headquartered Polymer Capital, picked Orix Corporation , a financial services firm, saying the change in management marks "a big turning point" for the company's transformation into a global investment firm.
"The new leadership has a greater focus on capital allocation and ROE," Nakayama said, adding the firm is now using overseas capital, including from Qatar Investment Authority, to bid for companies.
The number of activist campaigns in Japan hit a record last year, according to brokerage Jefferies, after years of pressure from regulators and the Tokyo Stock Exchange on companies to improve shareholder returns and invest in growth.
BEYOND DIVIDENDS AND BUYBACKS Fund managers said that the next chapter is not just about companies increasing dividends and buybacks but also about focusing on those deploying capital to expand businesses and drive long-term growth.
One example is Rigaku (268A.T) , an X-ray equipment supplier pivoting to semiconductor metrology, measuring and inspecting chips.
New York-based Indus Capital Partners said it had invested in the company and had engaged with the firm to sell a stake to a US semiconductor firm to drive revenue.
As semiconductor companies are going into vertical structures to scale, X-ray is needed to detect defects deeper in the 3D chips, said Byron Gill, managing partner at Indus.
Rigaku might be one of the few companies that "has the key to unlocking scale for the semiconductor industry in the middle of a super cycle", he added, forecasting a 100% rise in its valuation by 2029.
REFORM THEME DOMINATES The corporate reform theme still has a long way to run, market participants said.
"Japan changes slowly, but once the change starts, it does not reverse," said Naohide Une, partner and CEO at Investment Lab, a former senior managing director at Japan Post Bank.
He picked Japanese chemical company Ube Corporation (4208.T) for its corporate reform efforts.
In a separate Q&A session, Seth Fischer, founder of activist Oasis Management, said his fund may substantially increase its stake in Japanese electric motor maker Nidec (6594.T) .
AI AS A BACK-OFFICE TAILWIND AI was another key investment theme.
Investment firms Ruane Cunniff and Japan Catalyst picked software companies Money Forward (3994.T) and OBIC Business Consultants (4733.T) , respectively.
They argued that back-office software operators are AI winners rather than losers, as clients require accuracy.
And these businesses are helping Japan overcome labor tightness, they said.

items.title: Dólar se encamina a caída semanal por menor expectativa de alza de tasas de la Fed
items.author: Stefano Rebaudo, Laura Matthews
items.creator: Stefano Rebaudo, Laura Matthews
items.summary: El dólar bajaba el viernes, en camino a su primera caída semanal en más de un mes frente al euro y al yen, en medio de menores expectativas de un alza de tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal y preocupaciones por una ola de ventas en las bolsas impulsada por la inteligencia artificial.
items.body:
El dólar bajaba el viernes, en camino a su primera caída semanal en más de un mes frente al euro y al yen, en medio de menores expectativas de un alza de tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal y preocupaciones por una ola de ventas en las bolsas impulsada por la inteligencia artificial.
* Los mercados se vieron sacudidos esta semana por datos de precios al consumo y a la producción más altos de lo esperado.
* No obstante, las autoridades de la Fed aseguraron que no hay urgencia por endurecer la política monetaria, contribuyendo a estabilizar el rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro y minando el apoyo al dólar.
* Las acciones del sector de la IA cayeron esta semana y la tensión se extendió a sectores del mercado crediticio, ya que los inversores a lo largo de toda la cadena de suministro temen ahora que los operadores de centros de datos no logren ser rentables a tiempo para pagar sus deudas.
* "Desde mediados de junio, con un Comité Federal de Mercado Abierto de tono agresivo, las tasas han estado impulsando el dólar, y ahora parece que la preocupación sobre la sostenibilidad de la IA están contrarrestando ese efecto", dijo Marc Chandler, de Bannockburn Capital Markets.
* El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde con una cesta de seis destacadas divisas, caía un 0,42% a 101,61 unidades, en camino a un descenso semanal del 0,6%.
* La libra esterlina ganaba un 0,6%, a 1,3353 dólares, con un alza acumulada del 0,92% en la semana, mientras que el dólar restaba un 0,48% ante el franco suizo, al 0,8228%, lo que supone un declive semanal del 0,92%.
* El euro
subía un 0,33%, a 1,1255 dólares, tras mejorar un 0,56% el jueves, su mayor avance diario en dos meses y en camino a un alza semanal del 0,48%. Frente al yen, el dólar cedía un 0,12%, a 157,79 unidades, cerca de poner fin a cuatro semanas seguidas a la baja.

items.title: 欧州、債務持続性へ成長加速と赤字削減を＝ＩＭＦ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jan Strupczewski

［バンコク　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Jan Strupczewski

［バンコク　１６日　ロイター］ - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は１６日、欧州各国が公的債務を持続可能な水準に維持するには成長を加速させるか、借り入れを減らす必要があるとし、「何もしないという選択肢はない」と警告した。

ＩＭＦは１３日、ユーロ圏の経済成長率について、４月時点と同じく２０２６年が１．１％、２７年は１．２％と予想した。インフレ率は、２６年が３．１％、２７年が２．８％、２８年が２．２％になると予測した。

ＩＭＦは「債務の持続可能性を保つには、欧州諸国の約４分の３で、成長を高めて歳出圧力を緩和する構造改革と、中期的に国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比で平均約３．５％に相当する財政赤字削減策を組み合わせる必要がある」と指摘した。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）全加盟国が欧州委員会と合意しなければならない「中期財政・構造計画」で予定されている財政再建規模はＧＤＰ比で平均約２％にとどまり、一部の国で必要とされる水準を下回っているという。

「スタッフの基本予測は、大半の国で財政再建が計画を下回ることを示しており、想定されている再建規模でさえ達成が困難となる恐れがある」と指摘。

「欧州諸国の約４分の１は、公的債務を持続可能にするためにＧＤＰ比で５％超の財政再建が必要となる。これは過去に実行可能と証明された水準を上回っており、政府活動の範囲を見直し、不足分を補うために民間部門の役割を拡大する以外に選択肢はない」と分析した。

欧州委が５月に発表した予測によると、ＥＵ全体の債務の対ＧＤＰ比率は、２５年末時点の８２．８％から２６年に８４．２％、２７年末までには８５．３％へ上昇する見通し。ユーロ圏の比率も２５年の８８．７％から２６年に９０．２％に上昇し、２７年には９１．２％に達すると予測されている。

ＩＭＦ欧州局長のマテウシュ・シュチュレク氏はロイターに対し、「高齢化、国防費増額、エネルギー移行など、欧州の大半の国が直面している長期的な歳出課題を勘案すると、政策変更がなければ欧州の平均的な経済において公的債務は大幅に増加し、現在の水準の最大２倍に達する可能性がある」と述べ、中欧の高成長国の一部では、この債務拡大のペースがさらに速くなる可能性があるとした。

「持続可能性の定義が（債務の）増大を止めて安定化させられるかどうかであるなら、財政面での対応と再建が不可欠だ」とし、「より早く動く方が常に対処費用は少なくて済む。着手が遅れるほど調整は難しくなる」と語った。

ＩＭＦは欧州の成長加速に向けた最大の障害は低水準の生産性だと指摘し、各国政府に対してＥＵ域内市場の障壁を取り除き、技術革新（イノベーション）や事業拡大への投資を行うよう求めた。

「一定の改革に向けた取り組みが進められているものの、未完成のＥＵ単一市場と各国の障壁が、企業の事業調整や規模拡大、より大きな市場へのアクセスを困難にしている」とした。

また、化石燃料から再生可能エネルギーへの移行を継続し、重要鉱物を含む世界的なサプライチェーン（供給網）の多様化を進めるよう呼びかけた。これらは全てＥＵが既に取り組んでいる政策方針となる。

items.title: Shell agrees proposed sale of French fuel stations to DCC Energy, source says
items.author: Stephanie Kelly, Dimitri Rhodes
items.creator: Stephanie Kelly, Dimitri Rhodes
items.summary: Shell has agreed a deal with Dublin-based DCC Energy for the proposed sale of its network of fuel retail stations and related transport-fuels services in France, according to a person familiar with the matter and documents seen by Reuters.
items.body:
Shell (SHEL.L) has agreed a deal with Dublin-based DCC Energy for the proposed sale of its network of fuel retail stations and related transport-fuels services in France, according to a person familiar with the matter and documents seen by Reuters.
The agreement comes as Shell aims to focus its fuel retail and charging operations on key markets where it generates the majority of its cash flow, including the US, Canada and the United Kingdom.
The parties have yet to finalise the deal, although completion is expected in the second quarter of 2027, subject to consultation with employee representatives, the document showed. The transaction would include around 70 sites, eight LNG installations and the transfer of 35 employees, the document showed.
"Shell is considering a sale of its retail forecourts business in France," Shell told Reuters, adding that it would not comment further at this stage.
DCC Energy declined to comment.
DCC Energy, a sales and distribution company in Europe and the US, serves millions of customers across the industrial and public sectors and delivers off-grid energy solutions, led by liquid gas, the company's website said. It also operates service stations and fleet services.
DCC Energy would operate the stations under a long-term Shell brand licence, the document showed. However, Shell's core fuel supply operations are excluded, meaning the buyer would source its fuel independently.
The monetary value of the deal could not immediately be determined.
Shell's marketing unit, which includes its fuel and charging retail stations, reported $1.3 billion in adjusted earnings in the second quarter this year, compared with $1.2 billion during the same time last year.

items.title: 仏借り入れコスト上昇、長期化なら財政健全化圧力高まる＝ＩＭＦ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jan Strupczewski

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jan Strupczewski

[バンコク １６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のシュチュレク欧州局長はフランスの借り入れコストが上がっていることについて、短期的には対処できるとの見方を示した。ただ上昇が続けば２０２７年予算だけでなく、信頼性のある中期的な財政健全化計画の策定を求める圧力が強まると指摘した。

シュチュレク氏はバンコクで開かれているＩＭＦ年次総会の合間にロイターの取材に応じた。現時点では仏国債市場はまだ秩序立った動きを保っているとの認識を示した。

「（市場には）流動性があり、（国債の）償還期間もかなり長く、投資家層も多様だ。銀行の流動性が高いことも支えになっている。このため短期的な債務リスクには十分対応できる」と語った。

一方、「利回りの高止まりが長引けば、財政とコスト抑制への圧力が強まる。財政の不均衡是正が急務であることを改めて認識させる。まずは２７年予算から着手すべきで、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の財政ルールに沿って遅滞なく承認される必要がある」と述べた。

フランスは２６年の財政赤字を国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比５．４％と見込む。２７年は５．０％への引き下げを目標としている。ＥＵの法令を順守するには、２９年までに赤字をＧＤＰ比３％未満に抑える必要がある。

シュチュレク氏は「それは確かに必要だ。市場の動きは、われわれにもフランスの政策当局者にも、その必要性を改めて認識させている」とし「市場のシグナルには政策を変える力がある。過去に何度も見てきた。ある意味では、債券市場から現実を突き付けられることで、財政調整のあり方が変わり、調整が加速する可能性がある」と述べた。

items.title: Oro anota caída semanal mientras los operadores analizan las señales de la Fed
items.author: Pablo Sinha
items.creator: Pablo Sinha
items.summary: Los precios del oro se mantuvieron prácticamente estables el viernes pero anotaron una caída semanal mientras los operadores sopesaban la posibilidad de nuevas alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal este año tras una serie de datos de inflación en Estados Unidos más altos de lo esperado.
items.body:
Los precios del oro se mantuvieron prácticamente estables el viernes pero anotaron una caída semanal mientras los operadores sopesaban la posibilidad de nuevas alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal este año tras una serie de datos de inflación en Estados Unidos más altos de lo esperado.
El oro al contado subió un 0,1% a 4.175,66 dólares por onza a las 1543 GMT, pero acumuló un descenso del 0,4% en la semana.
Los futuros del oro estadounidense con entrega en diciembre subieron un 0,6% hasta los 4.196,40 dólares por onza.
"Nos encontramos en un rango muy estrecho y nos inclinamos hacia el límite inferior de soporte, debido principalmente a que sigue habiendo mucha incertidumbre sobre lo que hará la Fed", afirmó Bart Melek, director global de estrategia de materias primas de TD Securities.
El presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, se mostró optimista sobre la solidez de la economía estadounidense, pero no dio pistas sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de interés del banco central.
Los datos publicados el jueves revelaron que los precios al productor de Estados Unidos registraron el mes pasado su mayor subida en cuatro años y medio. Estos datos se sumaron al informe sobre los precios al consumo del miércoles, que mostraba una aceleración de los precios en septiembre.
El presidente de la Fed de Chicago, Austan Goolsbee, calificó los datos de "desalentadores", mientras que la presidenta de la Fed de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, señaló que la Fed podría verse obligada a subir las tasas de interés de forma más agresiva si se produjera un deterioro notable de las expectativas de inflación del público.
Los operadores esperan en su mayoría que el banco central estadounidense mantenga las tasas estables este mes, al tiempo que descuentan una probabilidad del 90% de que se produzca una subida de tasas en diciembre, según la herramienta FedWatch.
Aunque el oro suele considerarse una cobertura contra la inflación, el aumento de las tasas de interés tiende a reducir el atractivo de este metal que no genera rendimiento.
"Durante lo que queda de año, es probable que los precios del oro bajen ligeramente, a medida que la Fed siga subiendo las tasas y los temores en torno al fin del auge de la IA resulten ser temporales", afirmó Hamad Hussain, economista especializado en clima y materias primas de Capital Economics.
Entre otros metales, la plata al contado se mantuvo estable en 57,43 dólares por onza, el platino subió un 0,6% a 1.636 dólares y el paladio bajó un 0,2% a 1.124,25 dólares. Los tres metales anotaron pérdidas semanales.
